title: ficus psychotriifolia
intro: Ficus psychotriifolia, commonly known as Banyan fig or Banyan tree, is a species of fig tree native to the tropical forests of Southeast Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for centuries due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties that help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Ficus psychotriifolia include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit neuroprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
